audit.whatIsWrong: Three factual errors. His E is called 'Pillar of Filth' twice — it is Pillar of Ice. The page credits 'Q lifesteal' — Chomp saps attack damage and heals nothing in Riot's text; his healing is King's Tribute (an enemy unit dying near him) and Frozen Domain, which raises healing from all sources while he stands on it. And Subjugate is described only as stealing 'resists and HP' without the part that matters.
audit.why: Subjugate steals health, armour AND magic resist, doubling over four seconds — the MR he takes off you is MR he then wears against your own magic damage, so your burn gets weaker at the exact moment you need it. Frozen Domain being a healing amp is also why you must never fight him standing on it.
audit.corrected: Pillar of Ice named with its 1000 range and 21s cooldown, Chomp's 300 range and AD sap stated, the real healing sources named, and the MR-theft consequence added to report[5].t, whys[6] and late.

audit.why: The packet chart reads Skill / Lillia / Lillia / Lillia / Skill / Skill / Trundle and matches the prose on all three rows.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2 and 6 proposed as matched full+content pairs onto the packet chart; diff set to FAV.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as your guaranteed-gank spike; it is shared, and the ultimate comparison was never made.
audit.why: Subjugate is 120/100/80 against Lilting Lullaby's 150/130/110 — his ultimate is back first at every rank, and yours only sleeps targets already carrying Dream Dust.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why and phases[5].why rewritten to their stages; the cooldown comparison added to late and the Dream Dust condition to mid.

edits.before: Trundle has no dash and no ranged poke, so levels 1-3 are about abusing that — open with Q from range to last-hit, then once you have your Q+E chain you stack the sweetspot, drop a Swirlseed (E) slow on him, and chip with Dream Dust while your movement speed keeps you out of his bite (Q) range. Never walk into his Pillar of Filth (E) — if he walls you against terrain his W move-speed zone lets him close and bite, and a single connected Q chunks you and steals your AD. Bait the pillar, kite around it, and keep him eating burn.
edits.after: Trundle has no dash and no ranged poke, so levels 1-3 are about abusing that — open with Q from range to last-hit, then once the Q+E chain is up stack the sweetspot, drop a Swirlseed (E) slow on him, and chip with Dream Dust while your move speed keeps you outside his 300-range Chomp. Never let him wall you with Pillar of Ice (E): impassable terrain thrown from 1000 range on a 21s cooldown, and cornered you eat a Chomp that chunks you and saps your AD. Bait the pillar, kite around it, keep him eating burn.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 are your strongest window: full-rank Q, the Dream Dust DoT compounding, and enough mana to grind him down every time he has to walk through your E slow to reach you. He will try to sustain through it — his passive regen and Q lifesteal heal a lot — so don't trade aimlessly; force him to step into bad positions where the burn out-ticks his heal. At 6 your Lilting Lullaby sleep is a setup and anti-engage tool, but it's delayed and far better with a jungler, so treat it as insurance against his pillar all-in rather than a solo kill button.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 are your strongest window: full-rank Q, the Dream Dust DoT compounding, and a Trundle who has to walk through your E slow to reach you. He will sustain through it two ways — King's Tribute heals him whenever a unit dies near him, and Frozen Domain raises the healing he gets from every source while he stands on it, so never fight him on his own zone. At 6 Lilting Lullaby only sleeps targets already carrying Dream Dust and it is delayed; treat it as insurance against his pillar all-in, not a solo kill.

edits.before: This is where Trundle reclaims it. Once he is tanky, Subjugate (R) steals a chunk of your resistances and heals him massively in any extended fight, and a drain-tank with that much sustain simply out-lasts your DoT — your kite war stops working when he can eat a pillar-trapped all-in and heal back to full. Don't try to 1v1 him for objectives; use your movement speed and roams to make plays elsewhere, and let your team's percent-HP or kiting handle him while you convert your earlier lead into map pressure before his statcheck takes over.
edits.after: This is where Trundle reclaims it. Once he is tanky, Subjugate steals your health, armour and MR and doubles the theft over four seconds — and the MR he takes is worn against your own magic damage, so the burn weakens exactly when you need it. It is 120s at rank 1 against your ultimate's 150s, so his comes back first every time. Don't 1v1 him for objectives; use your move speed and roams to make plays elsewhere and convert the early lead into map pressure before the statcheck lands.

notes: The packet flagged 'Pillar of Filth' as a suspect name and it was a genuine fabrication — Pillar of Ice. Its other flag, 'Your Lilting Lullaby' in whys[4], is a false positive; the name is correct there. Frozen Domain's healing amplification is the interaction I would most want a Lillia to read here and it was entirely absent: standing on his zone turns an even burn race into a loss.
